# `channel` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/channel.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

The logical I/O unit (doc 10 §2.4, rank 37, in the shard of its module device). Its ID is
`v5(module, "channel", number)` (`ew_ids::v5::plc_channel_id`). Address, state, designation, symbol,
target and texts are derived where the record leaves them open (doc 10 §3.1–§3.5).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `channel` |
| File | `devices/<xx>.jsonl` |
| Rank | 37 |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`channel.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/channel.schema.json) |

## Types

### AddrSpec

An address specification (doc 10 §2.5): derived, deliberate, excluded or open.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: Module start plus the address-map offset (the default).

   Shape: `"auto"`

2. **Form 2**: A deliberate value; every deviation from the derived value is reported (EW-PLC-012).

   Shape: object { `manual`: [`PlcAddress`](#plcaddress) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `manual` | [`PlcAddress`](#plcaddress) | yes |  | A canonical PLC address (doc 10 §2.5), rendered by the configuration project's profile. |

3. **Form 3**: Not addressed ("do not include in addressing").

   Shape: `"excluded"`

4. **Form 4**: A typed open item; prints "TBD" and blocks release (EW-PLC-015).

   Shape: `"tbd"`

### ChannelKind

The kind of a channel (doc 10 §2.4). `multi_function` (IO-Link port modes, 1.0) is additive.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"di"` | Digital input. |
| `"do"` | Digital output. |
| `"ai"` | Analogue input. |
| `"ao"` | Analogue output. |
| `"counter"` | Counter. |
| `"io_link_port"` | IO-Link port. |
| `"power_supply"` | Power supply. |

### ChannelState

An explicit channel state (doc 10 §3.2); `used` is never stored, it is derived from the target.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"spare"` | Spare. |
| `"reserved"` | Reserved. |
| `"deactivated"` | Deactivated. |

### Endpoint

One end of a connection, a definition or a bond (ADR-0007, doc 03 §9): a connection point of a function
or a junction. Encoding (doc 05 §3.2): `{"cp": [function, idx]}` or `{"junction": id}`.

```
use ew_schema::Endpoint;

let e: Endpoint = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"cp":["d40b6e93-25f7-5c1a-9e8d-7a3f1c05b6e2",0]}"#).unwrap();
assert!(matches!(e, Endpoint::Cp(_, 0)));
```

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: Connection point `idx` of a function; its ID `v5(function, idx)` is derived, never stored.

   Shape: object { `cp`: array of ([`Uuid`](#uuid), integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s)) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `cp` | array of ([`Uuid`](#uuid), integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s)) | yes |  |  |

2. **Form 2**: A junction.

   Shape: object { `junction`: [`Uuid`](#uuid) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `junction` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2). |

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### PlcAddress

A canonical PLC address (doc 10 §2.5), rendered by the configuration project's profile.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `area` | [`PlcArea`](#plcarea) | yes |  | The area. |
| `bit` | integer (format `uint8`, min 0, max 255) or `null` | no |  | The bit, for a bit address. |
| `byte` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | The byte. |
| `size` | [`PlcSize`](#plcsize) | no |  | The access size; default a bit. |

### PlcArea

The area of a PLC address.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"i"` | Inputs. |
| `"q"` | Outputs. |
| `"m"` | Markers. |
| `"pi"` | Peripheral inputs. |
| `"pq"` | Peripheral outputs. |

### PlcSize

The access size of a PLC address.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"bit"` | One bit (the default). |
| `"byte"` | A byte. |
| `"word"` | A word. |
| `"dword"` | A double word. |
| `"lword"` | A long word. |

### SourceRef

The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |  | The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`. |
| `lineage` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The import lineage. |

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
